enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket over body. Keeps body still. Breathes slowly. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Places arm under pillow. Remains lying. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket to shoulder. Extends legs. Bends knees. Remains lying. Turns onto back. Places hands on abdomen. Remains lying. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a shower
enriched_activities.desc: Opens eyes. Sits up on bed. Swings legs to floor. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on water heater. Removes sleepwear. Steps into shower area. Turns on shower tap. Adjusts water temperature. Wets hair and body. Applies soap. Rubs body. Rinses body. Turns off shower tap. Picks up towel. Dries face and body. Wraps towel around body. Turns off bathroom light. Walks out of bathroom.

Enters kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator door. Takes out eggs, milk, and bread. Closes refrigerator door. Places items on counter. Picks up frying pan. Places pan on induction cooker. Presses induction cooker power button. Pours oil into pan. Cracks eggs into pan. Turns on range hood. Picks up spatula. Stirs eggs. Places bread into toaster. Presses toaster lever. Removes eggs from pan onto plate. Picks up plate. Carries plate to table. Sits on chair. Picks up fork. Eats eggs. Drinks milk. Picks up toast. Eats toast. Stands up. Carries plate to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and gathering work items
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out work clothes. Removes sleepwear. Puts on shirt. Puts on trousers. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Walks to desk. Picks up work badge. Places badge in pocket. Picks up phone. Checks phone screen. Picks up keys. Places keys in bag. Picks up water bottle. Places water bottle in bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag. Walks out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of house. Closes door. Locks door. Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Checks phone. Boards bus. Scans transit card. Walks to seat. Sits down. Holds bag on lap. Looks at phone. Gets off bus. Walks to hospital entrance. Opens hospital door. Walks to locker room. Opens locker. Changes into scrubs. Closes locker. Walks to ward. Greets colleague. Receives patient list. Reads patient list.

enriched_activities.activity: Working clinical duties, patient assessments and care rounds
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to patient room. Washes hands with sanitizer. Picks up clipboard. Checks patient identification. Greets patient. Asks patient about pain. Measures blood pressure. Places cuff on patient arm. Presses start button. Reads monitor. Removes cuff. Measures temperature. Places thermometer. Reads result. Records vital signs. Adjusts IV line. Checks infusion pump. Presses pump button. Administers medication. Documents notes. Walks to next patient room. Washes hands. Enters room. Speaks to patient. Assesses patient. Checks wound dressing. Changes dressing. Disposes old dressing. Washes hands. Walks to nurses station. Updates chart. Answers phone. Takes message. Attends care rounds. Reports patient status.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to hospital cafeteria. Picks up tray. Selects sandwich and fruit. Places items on tray. Walks to cashier. Pays for meal. Carries tray to table. Sits down. Unwraps sandwich. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Eats fruit. Wipes mouth with napkin. Picks up tray. Returns tray to rack. Walks out of cafeteria.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work, documentation and patient handover tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to ward. Washes hands. Checks patient list. Enters patient room. Assesses patient. Adjusts bed position. Presses bed control. Checks IV. Replaces IV bag. Documents in computer. Opens patient record. Types notes. Saves record. Closes record. Attends handover meeting. Listens to colleague. Reports patient changes. Receives instructions. Walks to supply room. Picks up supplies. Returns to ward. Restocks cabinet. Checks equipment. Cleans stethoscope. Washes hands. Prepares for next patient.

Walks out of hospital. Walks to bus stop. Stands at bus stop. Boards bus. Scans card. Walks to seat. Sits down. Holds bag. Looks out window. Checks phone. Gets off bus. Walks to house. Opens door. Closes door. Locks door. Removes shoes. Places shoes on rack. Hangs up coat. Walks to kitchen.

Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables, chicken, and rice. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Picks up knife. Cuts vegetables. Picks up chicken. Places chicken in pan. Turns on induction cooker. Pours oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs with spatula. Turns on range hood. Cooks food. Turns off induction cooker. Picks up plates. Places food on plates. Carries plates to table. Sits on chair. Picks up fork. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Stands up. Carries plates to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and washing dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Scrapes food into trash. Places plates in sink. Turns on tap. Picks up sponge. Adds dish soap. Scrubs plates. Rinses plates. Places plates in dish rack. Turns off tap. Wipes counter with cloth. Wrings cloth. Hangs cloth. Turns off kitchen light. Walks out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Presses power button on TV. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Places remote on sofa. Watches TV. Adjusts sitting position. Stretches legs. Picks up remote. Changes channel. Places remote on sofa. Watches TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out water bottle. Closes refrigerator. Drinks water. Walks back to living room. Sits on sofa. Watches TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on water heater. Removes clothes. Steps into shower area. Turns on shower tap. Adjusts water temperature. Wets body. Applies soap. Scrubs body. Washes hair. Rinses hair. Rinses body. Turns off shower tap. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Wraps towel around waist. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off bathroom light. Walks out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and browsing the phone to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on bedroom light. Sits on bed. Picks up remote. Presses TV power button. Turns on TV. Changes channel. Places remote on bed. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens app. Scrolls screen. Watches TV. Places phone on bed. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Replies to message. Places phone on bed. Watches TV. Picks up remote. Turns off TV. Places remote on bed. Turns off bedroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting the alarm and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Sits on bed. Picks up phone. Opens alarm app. Sets alarm time. Saves alarm. Places phone on desk. Picks up charger. Plugs charger into phone. Places phone on desk. Opens bedroom window. Closes bedroom window. Pulls curtain. Turns on desk lamp. Turns off desk lamp. Picks up book. Reads book. Places book on desk. Adjusts pillow. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket over body. Closes eyes.

Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Pulls blanket. Remains lying. Turns onto back. Places arms at sides. Breathes slowly. Turns to other side. Bends knees. Pulls blanket to shoulder. Remains lying. Keeps eyes closed. Body still. Continues sleeping.
